The API slice bootstrap ensures that UI transitions occur safely through well-defined data contracts. Shared loaders enforce modularity by abstracting data access, preventing tight coupling between route handlers and UI components. The correlation contract introduces a typed query interface early, allowing for model development without premature persistence concerns. Each step builds upon previous decisions, creating a layered system where failure modes are localized and predictable. The absence of schema migrations in early phases avoids breaking changes, aligning with principles of robust design in complex systems.
